messages:
incident-bot: Paging: High error rate observed on embeddings-route in us-west-2 — 5xx spike + latency > 2s. Triggering on-call.
sam (oncall): I’m on it, looking at metrics now.
jordan (infra): I see a sudden QPS jump originating from a small set of tenants, embeddings-heavy. Top upstream shows bursty batch jobs.
lee (sre): Errors are primarily downstream timeouts from the tensor workers, not model crashes.
maria (support): Two customers flagged production errors (acct: acme-corp, acct: study-ai). Both on embeddings.
sam (oncall): Customer impact confirmed: embeddings requests failing ~25% for those tenants. Chat and rerank mostly fine but some requests routed through same pool.
jordan (infra): Proposing immediate per-endpoint quota tweak: reduce non-enterprise embeddings quota to 30% of baseline and apply route-specific limit on embeddings-hot-route. Will carve capacity back to chat.
sam (oncall): +1. Apply temporary rate limit and disable rerank on non-critical tenants to free capacity.
lee (sre): I’ll run a surgical limit change. Command: ```infractl rate update --route embeddings-hot-route --consumer-group non-enterprise --qps 450 --reason "live surge mitigation"```
ops-bot: Action scheduled: infractl job #98765 queued by lee. ETA 30s.
jordan (infra): Also applying traffic weighting to prioritize chat route: ```trafficctl set-weight --route chat --weight 1.5 --route embeddings --weight 0.6```
sam (oncall): Making note: disabling rerank experimental flag for free-tier: `feature-toggle rerank/free-tier false`
maria (support): Notifying affected customers with ERT 30m; include workaround: fall back to cached embeddings or retry with backoff.
ops-bot: infractl job #98765 completed. Per-endpoint quotas adjusted.
lee (sre): Initial metrics look better — embeddings 5xx down from 25% -> 6% within 2 minutes. Latency improving.
jordan (infra): Traffic weight changes are in effect. Chat QPS stable. Embeddings QPS for non-enterprise offloaded by ~40%.
sam (oncall): On-call handoff in 20m. Summarizing: root cause = bursty batch jobs from a subset of tenants saturating embeddings pool; mitigation = per-endpoint quota reduction for non-enterprise, route weight shift, disable rerank for free-tier, targeted rate limits applied. Customer impact: degraded embeddings for some customers (ACME, Study-AI) — errors reduced after mitigation.
tayla (next-oncall): I’m taking the handoff. Will monitor for 1h and coordinate rollback once steady. Please paste timeline + commands in the handoff note.
sam (oncall): Handoff note: mitigation applied at 1967071860; infra job #98765; trafficctl change at 1967071880; rerank toggle at 1967071900. Monitoring shows stable memory on tensor workers.
maria (support): I’ll follow up with customers with an incident summary and ETA for full restoration.
lee (sre): Will run a slow-capacity restore plan: increment non-enterprise embeddings qps by 10% every 10m if 5xx stays <2%.
sam (oncall): thanks team — marking this thread as active mitigation. If anything regresses ping @tayla. :thumbsup:
